{{Quote|You should never have come here Imperial!|Walfer Whitehand|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Walfer Whitehand''' was a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], an [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] working on behalf of the [[Naboo Space Station]] engaged Whitehand and four other Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], and [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] them.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Walfer Whitehand appeared aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
